Tamil Nadu Man Rescued from Alleged Bonded Labour in Punjab, Reunites with Mother

A man from Tamil Nadu has been reunited with his mother after 23 years, following his rescue from alleged bonded labour in Punjab. He had reportedly been in solitary confinement for 18 years. NGO volunteers who assisted in his return expressed sadness at his departure. The man was originally from Tamil Nadu.
